descriptive.quantity: top-tuple Jaccard, Gaussian vs Gaussian-copula (descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: 8 models over 31 ensemble cells, min per-model 0.67. Withdrawn as an H-B criterion by the 2026-08-06 audit (M6): both rankings come from Gaussian estimators on the SAME samples -- the copula transform only removes marginal non-Gaussianity -- so agreement between them measures estimator similarity, not module stability. Stability across independent samples is what blueprint 19.3 asks for and what the campaign-scramble replicate now supplies.

perturbation_precondition.rule: perturbation-derived H-B criteria are scored only on implementations whose per-background eta is numerically repeatable at half the campaign time step

The repeatability RULE it consumes was prespecified in perturbation_inference.py before the half-step run; the minimum lineage count is new and is set by what a clustered bootstrap can estimate.

conclusion: H-G 5/5; H-B NOT EVALUABLE -- no computable criterion in this arm
